# Graph media extraction separates binary bodies from explicit bodyless success

The media-resource patch maps byte/binary string schemas to Bytes, permits specifications without components and classifies explicit bodyless2XX responses as NoBody. Accepted source retains the success split and Bytes output, while later type-generation structure differs. Its tests directly check GET byte type and parser counts; PUT no-body extraction is exercised without a separate NoBody assertion. A negative generated-string check is not generated-code compilation or HTTP/base64 validation. Keep the initial binary-todo phase separate.

Scope: Graph OpenAPI media-resource extraction.
